players.name: Tyrese Haliburton
players.inj_note: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Scottie Barnes
players.inj_note: Barnes (adductor) was not present at the morning shootaround, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.careports.

players.name: Anthony Davis
players.inj_note: Davis is questionable for Friday's game against the Hawks due to a right ankle sprain, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Jalen Johnson
players.inj_note: Johnson is questionable to suit up for Friday's game against Washington.

players.name: Immanuel Quickley
players.inj_note: Quickley (hamstring) is questionable for Friday against the Bucks.

players.name: Paolo Banchero
players.inj_note: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Kawhi Leonard
players.inj_note: Leonard has completed treatment to reduce swelling in his left knee and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

players.name: Trey Murphy III
players.inj_note: Murphy (knee) participated in shootaround and expects to play Friday against Minnesota, Jim Eichenhofer of the Pelicans' official site reports.

players.name: Anthony Edwards
players.inj_note: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

players.name: Yves Missi
players.inj_note: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.

players.name: Josh Hart
players.inj_note: Hart is out for Wednesday's game against the Bulls due to right ankle soreness.

players.name: Moussa Diabate
players.inj_note: Diabate (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Boston, according to the Hornets' official injury report.

players.name: Jarrett Allen
players.inj_note: Allen (knee) is questionable for Friday's game against Philadelphia.

players.name: Peyton Watson
players.inj_note: Watson (hamstring) is questionable for Friday's game against the 76ers.

players.name: Jalen Duren
players.inj_note: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

players.name: Jalen Smith
players.inj_note: Smith (hand) won't return to Wednesday's game against the Knicks.

players.name: Day'Ron Sharpe
players.inj_note: Sharpe registered 15 points (5-7 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 4-5 FT), 13 rebounds and four assists across 26 minutes in Sunday's 98-90 win over the Pacers.

players.name: Jalen Suggs
players.inj_note: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Jordan Goodwin
players.inj_note: Goodwin (calf) is out for Thursday's game against Orlando.

players.name: Ja Morant
players.inj_note: Morant has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and is expected to miss four weeks, Portland announced Friday.

players.name: Terrence Shannon Jr.
players.inj_note: Shannon (hip) has been ruled out for Friday's game against New Orleans.

players.name: Sandro Mamukelashvili
players.inj_note: Mamukelashvili (illness) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Portland.

players.name: Chet Holmgren
players.inj_note: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

players.name: Egor Demin
players.inj_note: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

players.name: Isaiah Stewart
players.inj_note: Stewart (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.

players.name: Kelly Oubre Jr.
players.inj_note: Oubre (calf) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.

players.name: Dennis Schroder
players.inj_note: Schroder (thigh) is questionable for Friday's game against the Celtics.

players.name: DeMar DeRozan
players.inj_note: DeRozan has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Raptors due to lower-back spasms.

players.name: Jaylon Tyson
players.inj_note: Tyson (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the 76ers.

players.name: Tyrese Proctor
players.inj_note: Proctor (ankle) is questionable to play in Friday's game against the 76ers.

players.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
players.inj_note: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

players.name: Keegan Murray
players.inj_note: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

players.name: Steven Adams
players.inj_note: Head coach Ime Udoka said Wednesday that Adams (calf) is still without a timetable to return and will be evaluated on a "weekly basis," Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports.

players.name: Clint Capela
players.inj_note: Capela (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the Timberwolves.

players.name: Jakob Poeltl
players.inj_note: Poeltl (shoulder) is listed as probable for Friday's game against Milwaukee.

players.name: Gui Santos
players.inj_note: Santos (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Heat.

players.name: Noah Clowney
players.inj_note: Clowney (knee) supplied seven points (3-6 FG, 1-4 3Pt), one rebound and one assist over 17 minutes during Wednesday's 114-104 victory over the Hornets.

players.name: Max Christie
players.inj_note: Christie (hip) is probable for Friday's game against the Jazz.

players.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
players.inj_note: Pippen (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Oklahoma City.

players.name: Adem Bona
players.inj_note: Bona (back) is doubtful to play in Friday's game against the Cavaliers, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

players.name: Jock Landale
players.inj_note: Landale (hip) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Wizards.

players.name: Jaylin Williams
players.inj_note: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies.

players.name: Isaiah Joe
players.inj_note: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Philadelphia.

players.name: Kon Knueppel
players.inj_note: Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Celtics.

players.name: Sergio de Larrea
players.inj_note: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against Utah.

players.name: Asa Newell
players.inj_note: Newell (toe) is out for Friday's game against Washington.

players.name: Rasheer Fleming
players.inj_note: Fleming is out for Thursday's game against the Magic due to a sprained left ankle.

players.name: Ben Sheppard
players.inj_note: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

players.name: Reece Beekman
players.inj_note: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

players.name: Zach Collins
players.inj_note: Collins (undisclosed) exited to the locker room in the fourth quarter of Wednesday's 135-105 loss to the Knicks, finishing with three points (1-4 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 1-1 FT), three assists, one rebound and one steal across 14 minutes.

players.name: Kyle Anderson
players.inj_note: Anderson is questionable for Friday against the Bucks due to illness.

players.name: Vit Krejci
players.inj_note: Head coach Micah Nori said that Krejci suffered a left leg fracture during Wednesday's 132-119 win over the Suns, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

players.name: Justin Champagnie
players.inj_note: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

players.name: Jalen Williams
players.inj_note: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Cason Wallace
players.inj_note: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
